selection: A/B fixed historical development segments, then A source ULog. Positive contiguous encoder and valid phase, airborne, native IMU/GNSS quality and reset checks. Two second context each side; no stitching or extrapolation across gaps.
weights: Heuristic effective IMU sigmas; GNSS receiver diagonal proxies plus fixed floors .1/.1/.2m and .15m/s. Joint six-dimensional Huber(3), equivalent to Stage02.6 G0. No calibrated posterior.
reference: Main IMU sensor point under rigid mounting assumption; GNSS zero lever and 110ms delay are uncalibrated hypotheses. IMU lever is zero by definition, not a calibrated COM location.
acceptance: Primary in_sample_observation_fit; held_out_observation_prediction auxiliary and not run here; independent_physical_validation unverified. FD target 5e-3 SI with step refinement, continuity limit convergence, midpoint quadrature refinement. No sensor-accuracy pass threshold invented. No tuning on residual minima.
phase_recovery: Cycle-balanced affine plus H1-H3 fitted to all valid native IMU. Subtract periodic terms only; fix all slow knots/biases during physical projection to slow-prediction plus template and original PVT. Projection targets are derived, not independent sensor observations. Final evaluate against original observations.
